+package trafficpolicy
+
+import (
+	"fmt"

+	envoyroutev3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/config/route/v3"

+
+type consistentHashIR struct {
+	disable      bool
+	hashPolicies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	otherCH, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil && otherCH == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	if c == nil || otherCH == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c.disable != otherCH.disable {
+		return false
+	}
+	return slices.EqualFunc(c.hashPolicies, otherCH.hashPolicies, func(a, b *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) bool {
+		return proto.Equal(a, b)
+	})
+}
+
+// Validate performs validation on the consistent hash component.
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	for _, hp := range c.hashPolicies {
+		if hp == nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		if err := hp.ValidateAll(); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		if hdr := hp.GetHeader(); hdr != nil && hdr.GetRegexRewrite() != nil && hdr.GetRegexRewrite().GetPattern() != nil {
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(hdr.GetRegexRewrite().GetPattern().GetRegex()); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern: %w", err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) clone() *consistentHashIR {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	out := &consistentHashIR{
+		disable: c.disable,
+	}
+	if len(c.hashPolicies) > 0 {
+		out.hashPolicies = make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, len(c.hashPolicies))
+		for i, hp := range c.hashPolicies {
+			out.hashPolicies[i] = proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy)
+		}
+	}
+	return out
+}

+func parseCookieTTL(ttlStr string) (time.Duration, error) {
+	if secs, err := strconv.ParseInt(ttlStr, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		if secs < 0 {
+			return 0, fmt.Errorf("duration must be non-negative: %q", ttlStr)
+		}
+		return time.Duration(secs) * time.Second, nil
+	}
+	d, err := time.ParseDuration(ttlStr)
+	if err != nil {
+		return 0, err
+	}
+	if d < 0 {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("duration must be non-negative: %q", ttlStr)
+	}
+	return d, nil

+// constructConsistentHash constructs the consistent hash policy IR from the policy specification.
+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+	if ptr.Deref(ch.Disable, false) {
+		if len(ch.Headers) > 0 || len(ch.Cookies) > 0 || len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 || len(ch.FilterState) > 0 || ch.SourceIP != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash: no other fields may be set when disable is true")
+		}
+		out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+			disable: true,
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	var hashPolicies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	// 1. Headers (deduplicated case-insensitively by headerName, preserving first occurrence casing)
+	if len(ch.Headers) > 0 {
+		seenHeaders := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.Headers))
+		for _, h := range ch.Headers {
+			key := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+			if _, exists := seenHeaders[key]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seenHeaders[key] = struct{}{}
+
+			headerPolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+				HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+			}
+			if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+				headerPolicy.RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+					Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+						Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+					},
+					Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+				}
+			}
+			hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+					Header: headerPolicy,
+				},
+				Terminal: ptr.Deref(h.Terminal, false),
+			})
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 2. Cookies (deduplicated by name)
+	if len(ch.Cookies) > 0 {
+		seenCookies := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.Cookies))
+		for _, c := range ch.Cookies {
+			if _, exists := seenCookies[c.Name]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seenCookies[c.Name] = struct{}{}
+
+			cookiePolicy := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+				Name: c.Name,
+			}
+			if c.TTL != nil && *c.TTL != "" {
+				ttlDuration, err := parseCookieTTL(*c.TTL)
+				if err != nil {
+					return fmt.Errorf("invalid cookie ttl for %q: %w", c.Name, err)
+				}
+				cookiePolicy.Ttl = durationpb.New(ttlDuration)
+			}
+			if c.Path != nil {
+				cookiePolicy.Path = *c.Path
+			}
+			if len(c.Attributes) > 0 {
+				attrs := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, 0, len(c.Attributes))
+				for _, attr := range c.Attributes {
+					attrs = append(attrs, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+						Name:  attr.Name,
+						Value: attr.Value,
+					})
+				}
+				cookiePolicy.Attributes = attrs
+			}
+			hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+					Cookie: cookiePolicy,
+				},
+				Terminal: ptr.Deref(c.Terminal, false),
+			})
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 3. QueryParameters (deduplicated by name)
+	if len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 {
+		seenQueryParams := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.QueryParameters))
+		for _, qp := range ch.QueryParameters {
+			if _, exists := seenQueryParams[qp.Name]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seenQueryParams[qp.Name] = struct{}{}
+
+			hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+					QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+						Name: qp.Name,
+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: ptr.Deref(qp.Terminal, false),
+			})
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 4. FilterState (deduplicated by key)
+	if len(ch.FilterState) > 0 {
+		seenFilterState := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.FilterState))
+		for _, fs := range ch.FilterState {
+			if _, exists := seenFilterState[fs.Key]; exists {
+				continue
+			}
+			seenFilterState[fs.Key] = struct{}{}
+
+			hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+					FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+						Key: fs.Key,
+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: ptr.Deref(fs.Terminal, false),
+			})
+		}
+	}
+
+	// 5. SourceIP
+	if ch.SourceIP != nil {
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(ch.SourceIP.Terminal, false),
+		})
+	}
+
+	// Default to a single sourceIp hash policy with terminal=false if no sub-fields are specified
+	if len(hashPolicies) == 0 {
+		hashPolicies = append(hashPolicies, defaultSourceIPHashPolicy())
+	}
+
+	out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+		hashPolicies: hashPolicies,
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+// mergeConsistentHashIR unions array fields across high and low priority policies,
+// deduplicating by key, retaining high's sourceIp scalar even when unset,
+// and sorting the merged result in canonical type order.
+func mergeConsistentHashIR(high, low *consistentHashIR) *consistentHashIR {
+	var (
+		headers      []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+		cookies      []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+		queryParams  []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+		filterStates []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+		sourceIP     *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	)
+
+	seenHeaders := make(map[string]struct{})
+	seenCookies := make(map[string]struct{})
+	seenQueryParams := make(map[string]struct{})
+	seenFilterStates := make(map[string]struct{})
+
+	collectFrom := func(ir *consistentHashIR, includeSourceIP bool) {
+		if ir == nil {
+			return
+		}
+		for _, hp := range ir.hashPolicies {
+			if hp == nil {
+				continue
+			}
+			switch spec := hp.GetPolicySpecifier().(type) {
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_:
+				if spec.Header == nil {
+					continue
+				}
+				key := strings.ToLower(spec.Header.GetHeaderName())
+				if _, exists := seenHeaders[key]; !exists {
+					seenHeaders[key] = struct{}{}
+					headers = append(headers, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+				}
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_:
+				if spec.Cookie == nil {
+					continue
+				}
+				key := spec.Cookie.GetName()
+				if _, exists := seenCookies[key]; !exists {
+					seenCookies[key] = struct{}{}
+					cookies = append(cookies, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+				}
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_:
+				if spec.QueryParameter == nil {
+					continue
+				}
+				key := spec.QueryParameter.GetName()
+				if _, exists := seenQueryParams[key]; !exists {
+					seenQueryParams[key] = struct{}{}
+					queryParams = append(queryParams, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+				}
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_:
+				if spec.FilterState == nil {
+					continue
+				}
+				key := spec.FilterState.GetKey()
+				if _, exists := seenFilterStates[key]; !exists {
+					seenFilterStates[key] = struct{}{}
+					filterStates = append(filterStates, proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy))
+				}
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_:
+				if includeSourceIP && spec.ConnectionProperties != nil && sourceIP == nil {
+					sourceIP = proto.Clone(hp).(*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy)
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	collectFrom(high, true)
+	collectFrom(low, false)
+
+	merged := slices.Concat(headers, cookies, queryParams, filterStates)
+	if sourceIP != nil {
+		merged = append(merged, sourceIP)
+	}
+
+	return &consistentHashIR{
+		hashPolicies: merged,
+	}
+}
+
+// applyConsistentHash applies consistent hash configuration to the Envoy route.
+func applyConsistentHash(ch *consistentHashIR, out *envoyroutev3.Route) {
+	if ch == nil || out == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	action := out.GetRoute()
+	if action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	if ch.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+
+	if len(ch.hashPolicies) == 0 {
+		action.HashPolicy = []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			defaultSourceIPHashPolicy(),
+		}
+		return
+	}
+
+	action.HashPolicy = ch.hashPolicies
+}

+func mergeConsistentHash(
+	p1, p2 *TrafficPolicy,
+	p2Ref *ir.AttachedPolicyRef,
+	p2MergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	opts policy.MergeOptions,
+	mergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	tpOpts TrafficPolicyMergeOpts,
+) {

+		opts.Strategy = policy.ToInternalMergeStrategy(tpOpts.ConsistentHash)
+	}
+	if p2.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if p1.spec.consistentHash == nil {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = p2.spec.consistentHash.clone()
+		mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		return
+	}

+	low := p2.spec.consistentHash
+	if opts.Strategy == policy.OverridableShallowMerge || opts.Strategy == policy.OverridableDeepMerge {
+		high = p2.spec.consistentHash
+		low = p1.spec.consistentHash
+	}
+
+	if high.disable {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{disable: true}
+		if high == p2.spec.consistentHash {
+			mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)

+		if high == p2.spec.consistentHash {
+			mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		}
